high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "live_mint." The post features two men working together to cut sugarcane stalks using a mechanical tool. The setting appears to be an agricultural field with green crops in the background and a clear sky above. The text overlay on the image reads: "Cabinet approves highest ever FRP for sugarcane farmers" in bold white and orange fonts. This indicates that the post is about a government decision to approve a higher Farmgate Reference Price (FRP) for sugarcane farmers.
